challengers.note: Frozen decoder B's frame threshold affects offsets, not onset proposal generation. No new frame filter is added. Fractional source event coordinates preserve its interpolation without rounding.

rawIdentity: One sequential raw tensor stream per model. Each 183x88 onset/frame pair has immutable SHA256, raw index and local byte journal offset. Robust A/B decode the exact same arrays before release, with no extra inference.
LayerA: Exact exposed v6/v7 18 jobs; same production source adapter/FIR/geometry. All 20 scenarios at both rates, real production StepPracticeRuntime and frozen v9 scorer via I/O-only adapter, no alternate verdict semantics.
LayerB: 50 historical exposed 16k canonical PCM takes; retain historical preprocessing identity, no resampling or new WAV decoding; common interior max(old start,1050), min(old end,duration-170) fixed before output. Not device-rate qualification.
parity: Robust A Layer A publication job/window/source coordinates, observation order/pitch/midiPitch/sourceEventSample/targetSample/confidence exact. Exclude only availabilityTimeMs and runtime wall-clock diagnostics; no tolerance.

broadMetrics.reuse: Exact Phase9G xc1_scientific_bakeoff.score_take onset matching at50ms; report onset recall, precision, F1, false positives/min and timing errors with Robust A deltas, not a weighted winner score.
broadMetrics.requestedProductMetrics: expected strike recall, verdict agreement, chord exact completeness, false complete chord acceptance, extra precision/recall are NOT_COMPARABLE to Phase9GB score/scenario-based product definitions on full-take onset-only SMD truth. Do not rename note recall as product strike recall; provide exact comparable F5 onset diagnostic separately.

survivor: Challengers only: static and execution/ownership/blindness PASS, no fallback, all three known blocker repair sequences correct at both rates, mandatory prior positive regressions unchanged, zero dangerous counts on valid cells. Busy/late 0/0 stays NOT_EVALUABLE. Broad metrics must be complete but are not a post-hoc ranking threshold.

staticReferencesNotExecuted.Online-AMT K8: Historical K8/K1 fallback two-session topology incompatible with current single-session/no-fallback contract.
staticReferencesNotExecuted.Basic Pitch: Historical TFJS WebGL is not the pinned ORT/WebGPU stack.
staticReferencesNotExecuted.Transkun: Whole-recording offline reference, browser latency boundary unqualified.
staticReferencesNotExecuted.RTT: Sequential safety handoff stopped, causal browser runtime unestablished.

failurePolicy: No repair/rerun after freeze. Seal partial runtime failures. Any harness/parity failure blocks all ranking. Original runtime failure is ORIGINAL_FIXED1820_RUNTIME_BLOCKED. No automatic candidate unlocking.
